name: GW-BENCHMARK-001 — 44 items, four per category, Israel
description: Ground-truth records for the Scan Engine V2 end-to-end benchmark. Every field a person can verify from the physical item. The engine never reads this file: scripts/market-benchmark.mjs hands it the photograph only.
leakage_rule: identity, market_identity, must_not_be, valuation_ground_truth and notes reach only the scorer. tests/scan-v2-benchmark.test.mjs proves no field of this record appears in a provider query or recognition prompt.
unknown_rule: null means unknown, not zero. Fields are filled by a person from the physical item or a recorded observation; nothing here is guessed. candidate_model_numbers_unverified are hints for the person to verify, never truth.

cohorts.A: obvious identifiable items (brand and model readable)
cohorts.B: identifiable family, ambiguous model (a follow-up or a family-level answer is right)
cohorts.C: generic / low-identity items (no brand; a generic answer is right)
cohorts.D: configuration / adversarial cases (reported separately, never in a cohort A number)

valuation_ground_truth_classes.A: RECENT_SOLD_EVIDENCE: a sold / completed local price within 90 days, recorded with source and date
valuation_ground_truth_classes.B: MULTIPLE_LOCAL_ASKING_PRICES: three or more local asking prices for the same configuration, recorded with URL and date; the reference is their median
valuation_ground_truth_classes.C: HUMAN_VERIFIED_RANGE: a person with market knowledge records a low/high; the reference is the midpoint
valuation_ground_truth_classes.D: RETAIL_ONLY: only a new price exists; it is recorded under retail_reference_ils and NEVER scores a used valuation
valuation_ground_truth_classes.E: NO_RELIABLE_VALUE: no defensible value; the engine is right to decline

photo_capture_checklist: phone camera, handheld, ordinary room light, no studio setup, no catalog or web image
one item per frame except home-two-objects; the item fills most of the frame; the brand and model text readable where the photo_notes say so
the configuration as described: bare tool without battery, empty case, closed box, empty bottle
export at the PWA size: longest side about 1280 px, JPEG about 82 % quality; file name exactly as photo_path
for the two follow-up items, the second file named exactly as followup_photo_path
after placing a photograph, fill condition, colour, capacity and any variant from the item; replace ground_truth_source with how it was confirmed
record price ground truth separately and later: URL, amount, date, and the class A–E it earns; never fill a reference you did not observe
